description.content: Choose the shell every agent command runs in — PowerShell, cmd, Git Bash, WSL, bash, zsh, fish or sh — with discovery, an explicit path override, per-shell status facts, a fixed self-test, and a refusal before any process exists when the selected shell cannot be confined.
选择每个智能体命令运行所用的 Shell——PowerShell、cmd、Git Bash、WSL、bash、zsh、fish 或 sh；支持自动探测、显式路径覆盖、逐 Shell 状态事实、固定自检，并在所选 Shell 无法被沙箱限制时于任何进程创建前拒绝执行。
